payload.content: In Node.js 18 and later, the built-in fetch accepts a `signal` option. The simplest way to add a timeout is `fetch(url, { signal: AbortSignal.timeout(5000) })`, which rejects with a TimeoutError DOMException after 5 seconds. AbortSignal.timeout has been available since Node.js 17.3. To combine a timeout with manual cancellation use AbortSignal.any([controller.signal, AbortSignal.timeout(ms)]).
